events.title: Supreme Court reverses Fourth Circuit decision in Clark v. Sweeney
events.summary: The U.S. Supreme Court reversed the Fourth Circuit's decision in the case of Terence Clark, Director, Prince George’s County Department of Corrections, et al. v. Jeremiah Antoine Sweeney. The Fourth Circuit had granted a new trial based on a claim not asserted by Sweeney, which the Supreme Court found to be a departure from the principle of party presentation. The case was remanded for the Fourth Circuit to analyze the ineffective-assistance claim that Sweeney originally asserted.
events.why_relevant: This decision emphasizes the importance of adhering to the principle of party presentation in judicial proceedings.

events.title: Supreme Court reverses Mississippi Supreme Court decision in Pitts v. Mississippi
events.summary: The U.S. Supreme Court granted certiorari and reversed the Mississippi Supreme Court's decision in the case of Jeffrey Clyde Pitts v. Mississippi. The case involved the use of a screen to shield a child witness from the defendant during a trial, which the Mississippi court allowed based on a state statute. The U.S. Supreme Court found that the Mississippi court failed to make a case-specific finding of necessity as required by the Sixth Amendment, which guarantees the right to face-to-face confrontation with witnesses. The case was remanded for further proceedings consistent with this opinion.
events.why_relevant: This decision reinforces the Sixth Amendment's requirement for case-specific findings before denying a defendant's right to face-to-face confrontation.

events.title: Supreme Court releases opinion in Clark v. Sweeney (25-52)
events.summary: The Supreme Court released an official slip opinion in Clark v. Sweeney. Docket number(s): 25-52.
events.why_relevant: The Supreme Court's official opinion in Clark v. Sweeney is a primary legal source. Supreme Court opinions can define binding national law and alter the legal position of the executive branch, federal agencies, states, litigants, and democratic institutions.

events.title: Supreme Court defers stay application in Blanche v. Perlmutter
events.summary: The Supreme Court deferred the application for a stay in the case of Blanche, Todd, et al. v. Perlmutter, Shira (Docket No. 25A478). The application was presented to the Chief Justice and referred to the full Court. The decision on the stay is pending the outcomes of related cases, Trump v. Slaughter (No. 25-332) and Trump v. Cook (No. 25A312). Justice Thomas indicated he would grant the application for a stay.
events.why_relevant: The deferral of the stay application affects the timing and potential outcomes of the case, pending related decisions.
